title: Prophylactic Endoscopic Clipping of Diverticula (PECoD)
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the effect of endoscopic clipping of colonic diverticula in treatment of symptoms related to diverticular disease. Half of the participants will undergo colonoscopy without the clipping procedure and half will have colonoscopy with clipping of all visible diverticula.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Confirmed symptomatic diverticular disease (5 or more diverticula)
* Age range 18-90 years
* Retains capacity and medically fit for colonoscopy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Does not meet inclusion criteria
* Unable to give informed consent
* Patients with severe co-morbidities and substance misuse
